An unbound `relayer` / `feeRecipient` is 0 in the message, as the contract hashes it. Field values not set by the generator are fillers (keccak256 of the field path), not valid proofs or ciphertexts. `extra`: what the entry takes unsigned (`meta`: the `PayMeta` a pay entry takes last, pay-meta-tax T41; `pqzVerdict`: the `PqzSignedVerdict` a PQZ entry takes last, after the signature, the empty one of a PRECOMPILE token, group 3f). `release: "3h"` (group 3h, pqz-proof-path spec §9.3, C9): a row of a format 3h moved (the six PQZ debits gain `ownTag`); those rows leave the relayer and the fee recipient unbound at fee 0 (mode 0), 0 in the message and the calldata. `release: "three-keys"` (spec 2026-11-13 pqz-three-keys, CTR-PQZ-38, -40, -41): `PqzTransferArgs` gains `uFrom` and the two `PqzOpening`s (the two single transfers, fee 0 and unbound as their 3h rows), `PqzRollOver` is new (the holder's signed rollover, purpose `zether-auth`).
